home.heroTitleLead: A distributed inference network powered by
home.heroSubtitle: inference.club merges local AI with the cloud — a tailnet that puts your computer on the world's largest network of distributed consumer AI hardware. After all, the cloud is just someone else's computer.
home.needsNode: You haven't put a node on the network yet — finish setup
home.topologySubtitle: inference.club is a Tailscale tailnet that joins consumer hardware — RTX PCs, the DGX Spark, Apple silicon — so members can safely expose their inference through one unified API, across the whole range of AI modalities: chat, images, video, speech, music, 3D.
home.consumerBody: Sign up, mint a token, point your client at {endpoint}. One simple API — a superset of OpenAI, NVIDIA NIM, and other popular standards — serving the best and most popular open models for every major modality.
home.providerBody: Exposing local inference usually means ngrok, Cloudflare tunnels, or a custom tangle of ports and firewall rules. Here it's one simple container: run the agent next to {vllm}, {llamacpp}, or {ollama} and it routes requests straight to your local services.
home.archSubtitle: Follow a single request from your code to a GPU and back. The cloud control plane authenticates, applies your privacy rules, and routes — but the model itself runs on hardware you own.
home.step1Body: Members run {agent} next to their local LLM server. The agent advertises whatever models the server is hosting.
home.step2Body: Each agent receives a short-lived Tailscale key and joins our private mesh. No ngrok, no Cloudflare configs, no ports or firewall holes. Just WireGuard.
home.step3Body: Calls to {endpoint} route to an online agent serving the requested model. Streaming works. Latency is direct.
home.feature1Body: A superset of the APIs you already use — OpenAI, NVIDIA NIM, and friends. Swap the base URL and key; your existing SDKs and prompts just work.
home.feature2Body: Members serve the best open-weight models on hardware they own — Qwen, Llama, DeepSeek, LTX — for chat, images, video, speech, and more.
home.feature3Body: Requests reach providers over Tailscale, end-to-end encrypted. No public endpoints to scrape.
home.feature4Body: Connect with passionate local-AI enthusiasts and evangelists. Pool compute with people you trust, and showcase the best results consumer hardware can produce.
home.ctaBody: Sign in, mint a key, and you're live in under a minute. Bring a node whenever you have spare cycles — your hardware is the cloud now.
home.featuredSubtitle: Real requests from members — a showcase of the best results consumer hardware can produce. Click any card to see the full request.

hero.badge: Running on home GPUs right now
hero.subtitle: inference.club is a network of graphics cards in people's homes. Members share open models for chat, images, music, video and voice behind one address, for people and for agents.

gallery.title: Everything on this page was generated by the club
gallery.subtitle: Pictures, songs and voices from open models on members' machines. Each one keeps its prompt, model and seed. Pictures made again with the same seed come out identical.

ways.title: Say it, call it, or hand it to an agent

ask.title: Say it
ask.body: Open the Assistant on any page and ask in plain words, typed or spoken. It makes the song, files it in a collection, changes who can see it, and tells you what it did.
ask.example: Make a two-minute song about the first snow, with three pictures to go with it.

api.title: Call it
api.body: One API for every kind of model, compatible with the OpenAI SDK. Change the base URL and the key; the rest of your code stays.

agent.title: Hand it to an agent
agent.body: The club is an MCP server with 33 tools: generate, search your library, set visibility, manage collections. There is also a skill and a small CLI for agents that prefer a shell.

host.title: Put your own machine in the club
host.body: Already running vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama or a media model? Run the agent beside it. It joins the club's private network, announces your models and starts taking requests. You decide who may use them.

cta.title: Make something
cta.body: Sign in, pick a model, and the first result is usually back in seconds.

signals.title: Every kind of signal
signals.body: Words, pictures, voices, songs, video and 3D shapes all travel the same way: a request goes out, a machine in someone's home answers.
signals.label: Six moving lanes: words, a picture assembling from tiles, a voice waveform, music bars, a strip of video frames and turning 3D shapes.

thinking.title: Watch a model choose its words
thinking.body: Every word a model writes is picked from alternatives. The club's API returns those odds, so you can see where it was sure and where it was guessing. This is a real answer from a member's machine.
thinking.hint: Tap a word to see what else it considered.

exchange.title: People and agents ask. Members' machines answer.
exchange.body: Every request passes through the club, which checks who is asking and finds a machine that is free. The answer comes back the same way.
exchange.label: A ring of people and agents sending small lights through a central ring to machines, and larger lights coming back.

network.title: One lit window, then a street, then a town
network.body: Today the club is a handful of households. Each member who adds a machine makes it more useful for everyone else.
network.label: Lights appearing one by one and linking to their neighbours until they form a large network.
network.note: An illustration of growth, not a live count.
